mapper.select: SELECT emp_id, ename, email, phone, hiredate, department_id, job_id, hr_position_id, status, annual_leave_days FROM emp ORDER BY emp_id
SELECT emp_id, ename, email, phone, hiredate, department_id, job_id, hr_position_id, status, annual_leave_days FROM emp WHERE emp_id = #{empId}
mapper.insert: SELECT seq_emp.NEXTVAL FROM dual INSERT INTO emp( emp_id, ename, email, phone, hiredate, department_id, job_id, status ) VALUES( #{empId}, #{ename}, #{email}, #{phone}, #{hiredate}, #{departmentId}, #{jobId}, #{status} )
mapper.update: UPDATE emp SET ename = #{ename}, email = #{email}, phone = #{phone}, hiredate =#{hiredate}, department_id =#{departmentId}, job_id = #{jobId}, status =#{status} WHERE emp_id =#{empId}
